title: AFP: 80 Chinese naval and coast guard vessels monitored in West Philippine Sea in October, down from 101
detail: The Armed Forces of the Philippines reported on Nov 3 that it tracked 80 Chinese vessels (33 PLAN, 47 China Coast Guard) at four features in October, down from 101 in September: Bajo de Masinloc 41 (11 PLAN, 30 CCG), Ayungin Shoal 24 (13 PLAN, 11 CCG), Escoda Shoal 11 (8 PLAN, 3 CCG), Pag-asa Islands 4 (1 PLAN, 3 CCG). Single-outlet report of official AFP figures.
